conventions: Reference rho is the GR injection; deformed a=1 SNR at the same distance is provided by reading alongside. Power here means |delta_L|/sigma_comb separation, not detection probability. z uses log(1+x); point-evidence moments from local Gaussian model. All existing data are calibration, not blind test.
